headline: Preparing Your Home for an Interior Paint Project
articleBody: Getting your home ready for a whole-home interior painting project might seem daunting, but a little preparation goes a long way to ensure a smooth and successful outcome. First off, define exactly which rooms and surfaces will be painted – walls, trim, doors, ceilings, closets? Having a clear scope helps both you and your painters. Next, think about your belongings. While professionals typically handle moving furniture and protecting floors and other surfaces, it's good to discuss who does what beforehand. Consider removing smaller, fragile items yourself. You'll also want to address any major wall imperfections like large holes or cracks, although many pros include minor repairs in their prep. Make sure to confirm the paint brand, quality, and number of coats you expect. Establishing a clear start and finish date is crucial, especially if you have a tight schedule. A detailed written estimate that outlines all these steps, from prep to cleanup, is your best friend. This ensures everyone is on the same page and helps avoid misunderstandings during the project. Getting these details ironed out with an experienced team like Frasheski Construction will help ensure a beautiful and lasting finish.
